tools.name: search_games
tools.description: Search public GameDeal titles using lexical title, slug and verified alias candidates. Results are candidates, not proof of identity. Confirm canonical title, product type and slug before comparing offers.

tools.name: get_game_offers
tools.description: Get fresh, in-stock public offers for a confirmed GameDeal slug. Filter activation platform and shop type before limiting results. Prices retain original currencies; buyer ordering uses available EUR conversion. Open the GameDeal page to choose a shop; no purchase or affiliate visit occurs.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Get up to 90 days and 1,000 latest recorded GameDeal price observations for a confirmed public slug. Original currencies remain separate, but platforms, editions and regions are combined.
